Variants.Content: Woods and banks offer warning positions while assembly removes farm labor. Sclavenian war makes boats, messages and grain as important as continued fighting.

Venedian river defence needs warnings, boat guards and messengers. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Mobilization removes farm labor and consumes grain reserves.
